root_cause.text: `hv_pci_probe()` in the PCI Hyper-V driver explicitly freed the emulated PCI domain number with `pci_bus_release_emul_domain_nr()` on error, even though the PCI core later frees the same `hbus->bridge->domain_nr` again via `pci_release_host_bridge_dev()`, causing a double `ida_free` on the same ID.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `free_dom:` path that called `pci_bus_release_emul_domain_nr(hbus->bridge->domain_nr)` and changes the failure path to jump directly to `free_bus`, while the CVE description states that `pci_release_host_bridge_dev()` also frees `domain_nr`, triggering the “ida_free called for id=... which is not allocated” warning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the hv_pci_probe error path to jump to the correct cleanup label when workqueue allocation fails.
intent_record.what: In hv_pci_probe(), the error path for a failed workqueue allocation was changed from `goto free_dom;` to `goto free_bus;`.
intent_record.how: If `hbus->wq` allocation fails, the function now jumps to the `free_bus` cleanup path instead of the `free_dom` path, which changes which resources are released during error handling and avoids skipping the appropriate intermediate cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the emulated PCI domain release from the hv_pci_probe failure cleanup path.
intent_record.what: The diff removes the `free_dom:` label and deletes the call to `pci_bus_release_emul_domain_nr(hbus->bridge->domain_nr)` from the `hv_pci_probe()` error path, leaving the cleanup flow to jump directly from `destroy_wq:` to `free_bus:`.
intent_record.how: On probe failure, the code no longer releases the emulated PCI domain number before freeing `hbus`. This changes the cleanup sequence so that the domain release is skipped in this path, which may preserve the allocated domain number instead of returning it to the pool.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct described in the root cause is the explicit freeing of an emulated PCI domain number with the driver’s private helper (formerly `hv_put_dom_num(hbus->bridge->domain_nr)`), which caused a later double free when the PCI core also released the host bridge domain. In this commit’s `hv_pci_probe()` error path, that buggy helper is no longer present; the code now calls `pci_bus_release_emul_domain_nr(hbus->bridge->domain_nr)` instead. The remove path also no longer frees the domain (`-hv_put_dom_num(hbus->bridge->domain_nr);` was deleted). This shows the fix is already applied in the shown function/body context, so the vulnerable construct is absent here and the code already contains the correct handling.
